title: The instrument is the work
thesis: Building is cheap now; the instrument that can say no is the work.
claim: An instrument takes a candidate and a reference the candidate's author did not produce, compares them, reads a residual against a threshold, and returns a verdict that can be no.

inputs.label: candidate
inputs.note: What was built. Cheap now; there are usually several.

inputs.label: reference
inputs.note: Independent of author and model: synthetic ground truth, held-out data, a person doing the task, a coupon on the bench, a phrase set the model must transcribe.

comparator.label: compare
comparator.note: The operation that puts candidate against reference. Domain-specific; this is where the engineering is.

threshold.label: threshold
threshold.note: Set before the run. Moving it after is the skip wearing a lab coat.

skip.label: looks right
skip.note: Candidate to verdict with no reference. The dashed edge.

return.label: returns, reusable
return.note: The instrument outlives the candidate. Running it again costs nothing.

authorship.claim: AI-assisted; I chose the method and validated
AI-assisted; I'd want to study it more

knowledge.label: knowledge
knowledge.note: Where references come from and where instruments go. Every instrument built before.
